description:
Perform a schema migration on the 'demodb' database (user: admin, pass: admin). 

1. Add a 'Rating' property (type DOUBLE) to the 'Restaurants' class.
2. Add a 'Capacity' property (type INTEGER) to the 'Hotels' class.
3. Make 'Hotels.Name' MANDATORY.
4. Enforce constraints on 'Hotels.Stars': MIN = 1, MAX = 5.
5. Create a composite index named 'Hotels_Country_Stars_idx' on 'Hotels' covering 'Country' and 'Stars' (type NOTUNIQUE).
6. Backfill data: Set 'Rating' to 3.5 for ALL restaurants.
7. Backfill data: Set 'Capacity' to 500 for 5-star hotels, and 200 for all other hotels.

Use OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html) or the Console to execute these changes.
